items.summary_zh: 阿比什·马修 (Abish Mathew) 因其“干净的喜剧”和在节目中以古怪的方式解决社会问题而闻名，以下是有关当今最受欢迎的喜剧演员之一阿比什·马修 (Abish Mathew) 的一切。
items.summary_en: Known for his 'clean comedy' and addressing social issues in a quirky way during his shows, here's everything about Abish Mathew, one of the most beloved comedians today.
